exposure: Nihon Kohden linear inflationary non-invasive blood pressure (iNIBP) monitoring technology
deflationary non-invasive blood pressure (dNIBP) monitoring devices
outcome: Time to detect maternal hypotension during cesarean section
cohort: 100 women undergoing singleton planned cesarean deliveries under combined spinal-epidural anesthesia (CSEA) after 36 weeks of gestation
finding: The iNIBP monitoring technology detected maternal hypotension faster than conventional dNIBP monitoring during cesarean section without compromising the reliability of measurement.
